name: Outer Realm
body:
Bloodstalkers of the Order of the Outer Realm deal with monsters and mutations that exist beyond reality and the realms of sanity. They emphasize battle against aberrations and monstrous humanoids. Most who join this order are fey themselves seeking a more potent means of combating the everpresent Chaos that threatens their realm.

Note: A standard bloodstalker who wishes to join this order can exchange his stalker’s draught benefits against fey and undead for aberrations and monstrous humanoids at 1st level.

Understand Physiology (Ex)

At 3rd level, when a bloodstalker in this order identifies an aberration, evil outsider, or monstrous humanoid with monster lore, he can use a swift action to inform his allies.

Spells the bloodstalker and his allies within 30 feet who can hear him cast that normally target only humanoids can target creatures identified in this way as well. At 7th level, this extends out to all allies who can hear him.

Aberrant Magic (Ex)

Also at 3rd level, bloodstalkers in this order learn to cast hold person a number of times per day equal to their stalker’s draught bonus, but they can only cast that spell on creatures they identify with understand physiology. The bloodstalker treats his bloodstalker level as the caster level with these spells, and the saving throw DC for any spell cast with aberrant magic is 10 + 1/2 the bloodstalker’s level + his Charisma modifier.

At 11th level, the bloodstalker can spend two uses of aberrant magic to cast hold monster on any creature once per day.

At 15th level, the bloodstalker can spend two uses of aberrant magic to cast mass hold person instead with the same restrictions as hold person.

At 19th level, the bloodstalker can cast hold monster twice per day if he has enough uses of aberrant magic remaining, and he can spend three uses of this ability to cast mass hold monster once per day.
